# polaris_principal_role (Data Source)

Reads metadata of an existing Apache Polaris principal role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_principal_role" "analysts" {
  name = "data_engineers_role"
}

output "role_version" {
  value = data.polaris_principal_role.analysts.entity_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the principal role to query.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter.
- `federated` (Boolean) Whether the role is managed by an external identity provider.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties associated with this principal role.
